title: Serendipity: the lovely art of a happy accident.
excerpt: A chance discovery. An unexpected delight. Meet a word for the good things you weren't looking for.
content:
## What does serendipity mean?

Serendipity is the occurrence of a happy or useful discovery by chance.

## In a sentence

Finding my favourite book in that tiny second-hand shop was pure serendipity.

## Make it yours

Think of something good you discovered unexpectedly. Write a sentence about it using serendipity.
author: Gurus Classes of English
imageAlt: Serendipity: finding something good when you weren't looking for it.
